scenes.hook: H T M L Tables. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: Tables organize data into rows and columns. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: T R defines a row, T H a header, and T D a cell. Read the example from top to bottom.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw. Small changes in code can change the output.
scenes.tip: A caption can describe what the table contains. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: Use tables for data, rather than for arranging an entire page. Understanding this helps you avoid a common beginner mistake.
scenes.try: Create a table showing two skills and their practice time. Change one part, then compare your result.
scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
